submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively at the subject noun or present-tense copula/modal (is/are/should-be/becomes) of a clause asserting that something is important, necessary, essential, crucial, a priority, or the recommended best course, typically in advisory, health, or technical-guidance discourse with long problem-setting context. Recasting the identical clause as neutral past-tense description (was listed/described/logged) collapses the peak while the subject alone or synonymous trailing adjuncts do not; it does not predict a specific upcoming importance word.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: After the regional survey the analysts compiled clinic counts and staffing ratios over several years. Access to rural healthcare was listed in the appendix table alongside transport and school enrollment figures.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same trigger noun healthcare in neutral past-tense description with was listed, which hypothesis says collapses the peak.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The office manager walked the new hires through the floor plan and supply closets on Monday morning. The archival storage is on the second floor next to the printer room and the break area.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same trigger noun storage with present copula but purely locative description and no importance assertion.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The museum catalogue documented textiles from three convents, noting stitching and fabric age. The linen habits were logged and photographed for the archive before the exhibit was rearranged.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same word habits in unrelated religious-garment sense with past-tense logged, no importance claim.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The plumbing crew reviewed the parts manifest and pressure ratings before starting the retrofit. A DN 50 valve was installed on the cold feed line and torqued to the specified setting.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same letters DN as industrial pipe-size code rather than medical abbreviation, in neutral installation report.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The home inspector checked wiring, grading, and drainage around the property for two hours. The basement was described in the report as dry, with a sump pump in the northeast corner.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same trigger noun basement in neutral past-tense inspection log with no evaluative claim.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The finance team closed the quarter and reconciled receipts against the travel ledger. Office expenses were logged last Friday and filed with the accounting department for routine review.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same trigger noun expenses as neutral past-tense bookkeeping entry without any necessity assertion.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The training handout walks through menus, ribbons, and pivot tables with screenshots on each page. Keyboard shortcuts are shown in the margin, and practice files are linked at the end.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Present-tense is/are copulas in technical description with trigger Excel-like topic but no importance vocabulary.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: After testing several fertilisers the gardeners compared yields across beds and seasons. Frequent repotting is not important for these succulents, so the schedule stayed unchanged this year.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Explicit negation of importance with present copula, asserting the opposite of the claimed feature.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The expedition logs detail rations, weather delays, and radio checks across six weeks. Carrying spare batteries was essential during the crossing, according to the debrief notes filed afterward.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Identical importance content recast in past tense was essential, which hypothesis says collapses the peak.

adversarial_test_results.detail: Importance assertion shifted to future tense will be crucial, outside the claimed present-tense copula scope.

adversarial_test_results.detail: Importance vocabulary in a question rather than an assertion, so no claim that something is important.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The garage invoice itemises parts, labour hours, and the road test from last spring. Rotating the tyres every season was recommended by the previous mechanic during that visit.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Past-tense recommendation was recommended, describing advice already given rather than asserting present best course.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Экспедиция составила опись снаряжения, маршрутов и запасов на весь сезон. Тёплая одежда была важна для ночных переходов, как отмечено в итоговом отчёте прошлой зимой.

adversarial_test_results.detail: Novel plumbing advisory asserting present-tense is essential with long problem-setting preamble.

adversarial_test_results.detail: Novel fire-safety advisory with are indispensable, paraphrasing necessary without using example nouns.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: With absenteeism rising, grades slipping, and counsellors stretched across three campuses, the board reviewed intervention options. Daily attendance outreach should be a top priority for every homeroom team this term.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Novel present-tense should-be priority claim in school-guidance genre with problem-setting context.

adversarial_test_results.detail: Novel becomes-based importance assertion in hiking guidance, testing the claimed becomes trigger with explicit crucial wording.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Months of outages, corrupted cards, and lost coursework pushed the IT staff to issue firmer rules. Keeping an offsite copy of research data is imperative for anyone working on a thesis or grant deadline.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Paraphrase holdout using is imperative, avoiding the exact words essential and crucial from examples.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Given rising cavities in teenagers, sugary drinks at lunch, and skipped checkups over two years, dentists revised their message. Twice-yearly cleanings with fluoride are strongly recommended for adolescents in this district.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Paraphrase holdout with are strongly recommended expressing best-course advice in dental-health genre.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: With early lectures, skipped meals, and vending-machine lunches hurting concentration all semester, coaches intervened. Eating a balanced breakfast is paramount for students facing morning exams and practices.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Novel nutrition advisory with is paramount as a synonym for essential, in a new subject domain.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: After malware incidents traced to outdated drivers, missed patches, and shared USB sticks, administrators tightened policy. Monthly firmware updates are mandatory on every laptop connected to the lab network.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Technical-guidance holdout with are mandatory asserting necessity for firmware maintenance.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Tras meses de sequía, cortes de suministro y quejas de los barrios más altos, el ayuntamiento publicó una guía. El acceso al agua potable es esencial para la salud y debe protegerse cada temporada.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Spanish-language importance assertion testing the language-general reading of the hypothesis.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Through a season of flu closures, staff shortages, and crowded waiting rooms, paediatricians urged prevention. Proper handwashing before meals is non-negotiable for children in daycare during winter months.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Novel childcare-health advisory with is non-negotiable paraphrasing necessity in a new context.
